sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} green turtle was tagged at {release_site} and tracked for {days_tracked}: {species_rank_days}.
Adult green turtles graze mainly on seagrass and algae.
She stayed close: her farthest position, on {farthest_date}, was {max_displacement_km} from where tracking began.
Her record includes a silence of {longest_gap_days}.
Why the tag went quiet isn't recorded. The map shows the gap as a dashed line, not a guessed route.
